records.admission_verdict: Admitted for a later bounded SFT emit. Official dataset-format docs pin JSONL completion {text}, alpaca {instruction,input,output}, and OpenAI chat_template {messages}. YAML chat_template and masking stay sidecar config, not row mutation. Preference, stepwise, tools, vision, template-free segments, and pre-tokenized input_ids are refused.
records.deprecation_policy: A new admission-record version is required when Axolotl named dataset types, default chat_template keys, or required YAML fields for those SFT types change.
records.loader: axolotl YAML datasets path to local JSONL; conformance in item 10.7. Extra axolotl stays empty until a harness.
records.loss_notes: Default chat_template trains assistant turns. Completion/pretrain trains the full text sequence. The profile must not change Veriformis loss-policy IDs. Masking is YAML, not a row rewrite.

partition_mapping.evaluation: optional second datasets entry or split named in YAML; omitted when evaluation is empty
partition_mapping.train: datasets JSONL path in the sidecar YAML

row_mappings.notes: Axolotl type: alpaca. Veriformis instruction, input, and output keep those keys.
Axolotl type: chat_template with default OpenAI keys. Veriformis messages remain two turns, user then assistant. System roles and tools are refused.
Later emit remaps prompt to instruction, completion to output, and empty input. Not a named Axolotl prompt-completion type.
Axolotl type: completion under datasets, or pretrain {text}. Full-sequence loss.

records.workflow: Later emit writes local JSONL plus a dataset-only YAML sidecar. The exporter does not train. Chat template choice is documented, not applied as a membership change.

records.admission_verdict: Admitted for a later bounded SFT emit. Official data/README.md pins alpaca and sharegpt over json, jsonl, csv, parquet, and arrow, with a required dataset_info.json sidecar. Ranking, tools, multimodal, KTO, and history extras are refused.
records.deprecation_policy: A new admission-record version is required when LLaMA-Factory alpaca/sharegpt column names, dataset_info.json fields, or ranking/tools/multimodal requirements change.
records.loader: llamafactory dataset_info.json plus local files; conformance in item 10.7. Extra llama-factory stays empty until a harness.
records.loss_notes: Alpaca SFT concatenates instruction and input as the user prompt and trains on output. ShareGPT trains gpt/assistant turns. The profile must not change Veriformis loss-policy IDs.

partition_mapping.evaluation: dataset_info.json split override or a second dataset name; omitted when evaluation is empty

row_mappings.notes: LLaMA-Factory alpaca SFT. instruction, input, and output keep those keys. system and history columns are not emitted.
Later emit remaps two-turn user/assistant messages to conversations with from/value tags human and gpt. tools, observation, and function_call roles are refused.
Later emit remaps prompt to instruction, completion to output, and empty input.
LLaMA-Factory pre-training uses the text column. dataset_info.json maps columns.prompt to text.

records.workflow: Later emit writes local alpaca or sharegpt files plus dataset_info.json. The exporter does not train.

records.admission_verdict: Experimental, not executable. Official dataset guide describes Alpaca, ShareGPT, and ChatML conventions consumed through Python load_dataset, get_chat_template, and TRL SFTTrainer. There is no stable machine-checkable destination file tree independent of model chat templates. Item 10.3-10.5 must not emit an Unsloth profile from this pin.
records.deprecation_policy: Re-review when Unsloth publishes a versioned, file-level dataset contract that a later pin can check without a model tokenizer.
records.loader: Not executable. Unsloth notebooks load Hugging Face datasets or JSON and apply tokenizer chat templates. Extra unsloth stays empty.
records.loss_notes: Unsloth SFT typically trains completions after a chat template. That template is model-bound and is not a Veriformis loss-policy ID. This pin does not authorize an emit.

partition_mapping.evaluation: not mapped; Unsloth notebooks select a Hugging Face split in Python
partition_mapping.train: not mapped; Unsloth notebooks load a train split in Python

row_mappings.notes: Documented Alpaca convention only. Not a pinned Unsloth file contract.
Documented ChatML messages or ShareGPT conversations after standardize_sharegpt. Model chat templates remain Unsloth-side.
Documented continued-pretraining raw text convention. Not a pinned file tree.

records.workflow: Do not emit Unsloth files from this pin. Core extra stays empty. Unsloth Studio UI is AGPL-3.0 and is out of this pin; the core package license is Apache-2.0.

records.admission_verdict: Deferred to item 10.6. Aptus already has a stable first-party sibling handoff contract. It is not an ExportService consumer_id. Default seal still does not write the descriptor. MLX backend rejects plain text rows.
records.deprecation_policy: A new admission-record version is required when aptus-handoff-v1 required checks, assignment digest, or backend_capabilities change, or when item 10.6 introduces an export consumer_id.
records.loader: Sibling name.vfbundle.aptus-handoff.json beside the six-file bundle. Not an export renderer. Item 10.6 keeps external-digest and assignment checks.
records.loss_notes: Handoff masking: prompt_completion completion-only, instruction_output output-only, messages final-assistant-suffix. text is rejected by current MLX backend_capabilities.

partition_mapping.evaluation: data/evaluation.jsonl in the sealed bundle, hashed in the sibling descriptor
partition_mapping.train: data/train.jsonl in the sealed bundle, hashed in the sibling descriptor

Two-turn user then assistant product rows. System roles are refused.
